Reuses the reviewed Domaine Heitz-Lochardet company link and the five-filings / 147-page Montrachet screening. No exact AH16 schedule accepted; the reviewed 2021 land contribution concerns other communes.

Reuses the reviewed GFA Marchal-Latour link and prior effort. Its existing cited statutes print AH93 (2537 m²), and recite the 7 December 2001 lease to Société Civile Domaine Louis Latour from 11 November 2001 to 10 November 2026. Original lease and current performance remain unreviewed.

Reuses the reviewed Domaine de la Pousse d’Or company link and the four-filings / 91-page Montrachet screening. Opale’s former AH150/151 ownership is retained separately and does not establish Pousse tenancy or present operation.

Reuses the reviewed Domaine de Montille company identity and the prior six-filings / 104-page search. The distinct SCI Montille et Partners and GFV Le Chevalier de Puligny identifiers are not merged into this company by name or shared management.

Reuses the reviewed Bouchard corporate-group link and the five-filings / 146-page Montrachet screening. No exact Chevalier parcel schedule accepted in this bounded corpus; the 2026 business contribution excludes vineyard property.

Two filings / 47 pages identify SCI Montille et Partners and its capital held predominantly by Bourgogne Investissement. The formation authorises a SAFER substitution under a BPCE Domaine promise, without an individual vineyard schedule or a named operating-company tenant. A shared manager with a producer is not a tenancy or control crosswalk; no domaine link or exact AH169 filing is accepted.

Nine filings / 105 pages identify the GFV and describe long-term leases to unnamed SCEA companies. The governance clauses and individual founder do not identify a tenant company. The formation mandate concerns a BPCE/SAFER transaction without an individual AH171 schedule. No producer link or exact current-parcel filing is accepted.

Reuses the reviewed Domaine Leflaive company identity and the four-filings / 111-page Montrachet screening. No exact AH77/AH148 schedule accepted. The company is distinct from the Leflaive GFA and a corporate identity does not establish present operation.
Reuses the reviewed Domaine d’Auvenay company identity and the prior three-filings / 113-page Bonnes-Mares search. No new exact AH126 schedule or current farming claim is asserted.

The reused Jacques Prieur statutes print current AH8 (724 m²), matching the recorded holder and cadastral area; the registry and estate legal notice identify company 778233098. Printed AH3 (641 m²) remains unmatched: equal area does not identify AH123, whose documented predecessor is H123. Current farming remains unverified.

externalResearch.title: Opale: retired AH150 and documented daughters
externalResearch.finding: The 23 June 2006 Opale contribution names retired AH150 (981 m²). Official DFI document 210:512:000:0000463, validated 21 March 2019, divides it into AH182 (794 m²) and AH183 (187 m²). Both belong to this cru and retain the full event qualifications. The filing reaches them only through that documented path; no tenant or current farming is transferred.

accessGaps: Cadastral named areas are reviewed. The cru name also identifies a smaller constituent, so white wines retain the whole-cru INAO outline. No producer holding is inferred.
Source boundaries, failed notice downloads and unsearched intervals are reported in the history coverage; none means no historical record.
Current farming remains unconfirmed for every parcel.
INPI and Pappers each returned HTTP 403 in the first batch attempt. The same shared access gap applies; public registry and actes.ccm2.net records were used.

New Chevalier company screening: 11 distinct filings / 152 pages, all OCR-screened at 150 dpi with RapidOCR and DirectML. Existing shared links, searches and effort were reused and remain unchanged; two cited Latour PDF hashes were reverified and relevant page images compared.

Louis Violland, the municipality, SCI Montille et Partners and GFV Le Chevalier de Puligny-Montrachet have explicit no-link searches. Similar names, individual managers and unnamed SCEA lease clauses do not establish a producer company relationship.
Three exact current-parcel matches are accepted: AH8, AH92 and AH93. Opale AH150/151 are external historical context. Printed Prieur AH3 remains unmatched to AH123 despite equal area.
The GFV formation copy prints 14 May 2011 but references a February 2012 promise and was deposited June 2012; the date conflict remains unresolved and is not used as a land-transfer date.

Eight requested Chevalier Winehog subscriber copies remain unsupplied. Their public URLs and dates are listed in filings.md; acquired-copy SHA-256 is unavailable until supplied. No subscriber parcel matches accepted.

Bouchard’s HTML holding pages returned HTTP 500; the freely available La Cabotte technical sheet was obtained. The Prieur 2017 technical sheet was reviewed but gives no holding area, so no census figure is inferred from it.

unmatchedPrintedReferences.limitation: The printed number is AH3, visually verified on page 9. Current AH123 also measures 641 m², but its documented predecessor is H123, not AH3. Equal area is not a crosswalk; no current match or corrected number is asserted.
